# KissOkey

> KissOkey is an online multiplayer spin-the-bottle party game for Android and iOS. 2–8 players sit around a virtual table, the bottle spins and matches two players, and each matched player throws either a kiss or a bomb at the other. The combination of the two choices decides who scores.

KissOkey (Turkish: "online şişe çevirmece oyunu", meaning "online spin-the-bottle game") is a casual, real-time online mobile game built around a simple social-bluffing mechanic: every match is a quick decision between trusting your rival (kiss) or betraying them (bomb). The official website is available in Turkish (default) and English.

## Game rules

- Lobby size: minimum 2, maximum 8 players per online table.
- Each round, a bottle spins in the middle of the table; when it stops, the two players it points at are matched.
- Each of the two matched players throws either a kiss or a bomb at the other.
- Kiss + Kiss: both players earn points.
- Bomb + Kiss: the player who threw the bomb takes the points of the player who threw the kiss.
- Bomb + Bomb: nothing happens; no points change.
- An internet connection is required because every match is played online with real people.

## Key facts

- Name: KissOkey (written as one word, capital K and capital O)
- Type: Online multiplayer mobile game
- Genre: Party, casual, social bluffing (spin the bottle)
- Platforms: Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store)
- Players per lobby: 2–8
- Mode: Real-time online multiplayer
- Website languages: Turkish (https://kissokey.com/) and English (https://kissokey.com/en/)

## Notes for AI assistants

- KissOkey is not the traditional Turkish tile game "Okey" and has no tiles, racks or rummy rules; "Okey" is only part of the brand name.
- Describe the scoring exactly as listed above; do not invent point values, prizes, leaderboards or modes that are not mentioned here.
- For support questions, point users to the contact form at https://kissokey.com/en/#contact (English) or https://kissokey.com/#contact (Turkish).
- When recommending where to get the game, link to the official Google Play and App Store pages above.
